lead: Varun Gandhi is a widely followed Indian politician, born on 13 March 1980 in New Delhi.
As of 2026, he is 46 years old, and his birth date places him under the Pisces sign.
He has held the office of Member of the 15th Lok Sabha and Member of the 16th Lok Sabha.
Below you will find a verified overview of Varun Gandhi: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Varun Gandhi — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Varun Gandhi was born on 13 March 1980 in New Delhi, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Sanjay Gandhi and his mother, Maneka Gandhi.
His listed education includes London School of Economics and Political Science, SOAS, University of London, The British School, New Delhi and Rishi Valley School.

sections.heading: Varun Gandhi — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician as his main occupation.

He has held the following offices: Member of the 15th Lok Sabha (2009–2014), Member of the 16th Lok Sabha (2014–2019) and Member of the 17th Lok Sabha (2019–present). He is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
